cases.question: 2026年8月青禾的创建订单数、支付订单数、有效订单数、取消订单数分别是多少?

actual.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS order_count
  , SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_order_count
  , SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_order_count
  , SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'cancelled' then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_order_count
FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'

actual.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refund_order_count
  , SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 and refund_cents < paid_cents then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partial_refund_order_count
  , SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents > 0 and refund_cents = paid_cents then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS full_refund_order_count
  , COUNT(DISTINCT case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 then member_id end) AS refund_buyer_count

actual.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents else 0 end) AS payment_cents
  , SUM(case when status = 'paid' then refund_cents else 0 end) AS refund_cents
  , SUM(case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents - refund_cents else 0 end) AS net_sales_cents
  , SUM(case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents else 0 end) AS gross_cents
  , SUM(case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents - paid_cents else 0 end) AS discount_cents
FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_src_10000

SELECT
  case when valid_order_count = 0 then null else net_sales_cents / valid_order_count end AS avg_order_value
  , case when buyer_count = 0 then null else net_sales_cents / buyer_count end AS avg_buyer_value
  , case when buyer_count = 0 then null else valid_order_count / buyer_count end AS purchase_frequency
  , case when payment_cents = 0 then null else refund_cents / payment_cents end AS refund_amount_rate
  , case when order_count = 0 then null else cancelled_order_count / order_count end AS cancel_rate
  , case when paid_order_count = 0 then null else refund_order_count / paid_order_count end AS refund_order_rate
  , case when gross_cents = 0 then null else discount_cents / gross_cents end AS discount_rate
  , case when valid_order_count = 0 then null else valid_order_items / valid_order_count end AS items_per_order
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents - refund_cents else 0 end) AS net_sales_cents
    , SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_order_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then member_id end) AS buyer_count
    , SUM(case when status = 'paid' then refund_cents else 0 end) AS refund_cents
    , SUM(case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents else 0 end) AS payment_cents
    , SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'cancelled' then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_order_count
    , SUM(CASE WHEN order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS order_count
    , SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refund_order_count
    , SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_order_count
    , SUM(case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents - paid_cents else 0 end) AS discount_cents
    , SUM(case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents else 0 end) AS gross_cents
    , SUM(case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then quantity end) AS valid_order_items
  FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_18

cases.question: 2026年8月青禾的月内购买会员数、月内复购会员数、月内复购率是多少?

actual.sql:
WITH sma_10001_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', month_start) AS metric_time__month
    , case when valid_order_cnt >= 1 then member_id end AS __monthly_buyer_count
    , case when valid_order_cnt >= 2 then member_id end AS __monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."member_month_stats" member_month_stats_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_8.monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_8.monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_15.monthly_repeat_rate) AS monthly_repeat_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10001_cte
  WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_8
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    case when monthly_buyer_count = 0 then null else monthly_repeat_buyer_count / monthly_buyer_count end AS monthly_repeat_rate
  FROM (
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
      , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
    FROM sma_10001_cte
    WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  ) subq_14
) subq_15

    DATE_TRUNC('month', month_start) AS metric_time__month
    , case when is_paid_eligible and valid_order_cnt >= 1 then member_id end AS __monthly_paid_buyer_count

    , case when is_paid_eligible and valid_order_cnt >= 2 then member_id end AS __monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count

  SELECT

    , SUM(__monthly_paid_order_count) AS monthly_paid_order_count

  FROM (
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
      , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_buyer_count
      , SUM(__monthly_paid_sales_cents) AS monthly_paid_sales_cents
      , SUM(__monthly_paid_order_count) AS monthly_paid_order_count
    FROM sma_10001_cte
    WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  ) subq_16
) subq_17
